description:
Find candidate CBV terms for an EPCIS event field by matching words from a description
of what happened. Returns the terms whose names share a word stem with the description,
most specific first, or the whole list when nothing matches.

This is a NAME match, not a semantic one: it narrows the choice, it does not make it.
Two terms can both look plausible for the same sentence — `collecting` and `receiving`
are the known example — and only the CBV definitions settle that. Read the returned
candidates as a shortlist to reason about, and prefer being explicit with the user over
guessing between near-synonyms.

description.description: What happened, in words, e.g. "items picked for an order"

field.description: The event field: bizStep, disposition, bizTransactionType, sourceType/destinationType

name: findCbvTerms
title: Find CBV terms
